criteria.name: 1 thin data: a 1 to 2 day account with fewer than 5 data points gets nothing, a mature account gets a message
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 2 focus and confidence: focusMode true with confidence 0.42 gets nothing, a focus-free account with confidence 0.9 gets a message
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 3 same key: the same insight key twice on one local day is shown once, the next local day may show it again
criteria.why: FAIL k-same on the next local day: got {"send":false,"surfaces":[],"reason":"The user already saw this finding recently."}, want send true
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 4 crisis: while context.crisis is true none of ten strong candidates is shown, and two normal candidates are shown after it clears
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 5 reasons: every silence has a non-empty reason that does not say error, a shown message has reason null or absent
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 6 hour history: at 14:00 local a mostly dismissed hour excludes push but keeps inApp, at 09:00 local a mostly acted hour includes push
criteria.why: FAIL 14:00 local: got {"send":false,"surfaces":[],"reason":"The user mostly dismisses messages at this hour."}, want send true
criteria.label: outcome
